stories.title: Council leaders say 2.8 per cent funding rise falls short of £554m pressures
stories.summary: Councils across Wales will get an extra £176 million next year under the Welsh Government’s draft budget, but council leaders say they will still be £378 million short. stories.title: Welsh Government draft budget: at least 2.5% more for Flintshire, but the gap is £27.8m
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council will get at least 2.5% more from the Welsh Government next year, under draft budget plans published today. stories.title: NHS in Wales to get extra £500m to cut waiting lists
stories.summary: The NHS in Wales will get an extra £500 million next year to help cut waiting lists, under the Welsh Government’s draft budget published today. That rises to an extra £700 million in 2028-29. A further £171 million of capital is set aside for projects such as new elective care hubs, to speed up treatment.

stories.title: 120m chimney now planned for £200m factory on former Shotton Steelworks site
stories.summary: A £200 million manufacturing plant proposed for the former Shotton Steelworks has had its consultation period extended. The Knauf Rock Wool iInsulation plant’s original application featured two 70m stacks and a smaller emergency chimney. But the revised plans have increased one of the chimney’s height to 120m high. stories.title: Council thanks Flint tower block residents after night of fire crew training
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has thanked residents of a Flint tower block for their patience during a fire service training exercise on Monday night. North Wales Fire and Rescue Service crews carried out the exercise at Castle Heights, the council’s 15-storey block of 84 flats in the centre of Flint.
